required_guard: Hash the actual opened raw file immediately before decode and compare to canonical registry
mechanical_proof_required: actual file bytes -> SHA256 -> exact canonical source SHA
why_required: Prevents filename row-count or cleaned-file substitution at direct raw entry

required_guard: Bind every accepted derivative to an immutable parent derivation receipt
mechanical_proof_required: derivative identity -> producer identity/config -> parent canonical source SHA
why_required: A declared source_sha256 inside a derivative is not parentage proof

required_guard: Require the exact frozen reader configuration for each canonical source SHA
mechanical_proof_required: source SHA + decoder version + exact encoding/config + authority status must equal source registry
why_required: Same bytes can produce different text/metadata under different reader configuration

required_guard: Carry reader_configuration and file_metadata into the candidate physical-realization identity
mechanical_proof_required: candidate receipt contains exact canonical digest of reader config and file metadata
why_required: Route-A validates these maps syntactically but drops them from the descriptor used downstream

required_guard: Require a full canonical physical-source geometry digest for any stream claiming source equivalence
mechanical_proof_required: canonical variable count + ordered ordinal/name inventory + row count + exact source SHA + extraction receipt digest
why_required: ExactPhysicalCellStream currently has only SHA row_count iterator transport identity
does_not_authorize: Permission to infer semantics from geometry

required_guard: Separate WORKLOAD_EQUIVALENT_STREAM from WHOLE_SOURCE_EQUIVALENT_STREAM
mechanical_proof_required: transport identity declares scope; whole-source claim requires complete source-native physical proof
why_required: Facade projected-slot completeness is sufficient for bounded semantic execution but not whole-source certification
does_not_authorize: Use of a narrow stream outside its exact workload

required_guard: Mechanically retain every canonical source variable including all-missing columns
mechanical_proof_required: ordered variable inventory and per-row physical-cell presence or explicit source-unrepresented state
why_required: All-missing columns may be semantically silent yet are source-native information

required_guard: Bind source-native topology/MR/rank/form metadata into a canonical physical metadata digest
mechanical_proof_required: exact MR sets occurrence/rank/slot/form definitions from canonical extraction
why_required: R5 preserves topology metadata but P2 terminal does not compare it

required_guard: Bind raw storage values separately from display/value-label dictionaries and verify both survive derivatives
mechanical_proof_required: raw code/value digest + display metadata digest + label dictionary digest
why_required: Display formatting can collapse identifiers and equal vectors can have distinct dictionaries

required_guard: Forbid formatted/display values from becoming respondent identity or raw-value substitutes
mechanical_proof_required: apply_value_formats=False plus reversible raw-value receipt in derivative
why_required: WVS1 S007 demonstrates display representation can destroy magnitude

required_guard: Require one source-specific governed routing/applicability projection shared by A/B/C
mechanical_proof_required: exact projection authority + routing facts/rules + risk-set refs + replay identity
why_required: Hash identifies the source but not eligibility forms masks or routing semantics

required_guard: Bind full projection materialization to its identity rather than trusting authority labels alone
mechanical_proof_required: full canonical projection preimage digest or trusted-producer receipt bound to projection_identity_ref
why_required: Current cache_identity omits most projection content

required_guard: Bind WVS structural preimage identity to the exact raw-hash-producing parent operation
mechanical_proof_required: raw SHA verification receipt + exact materializer blob + structural_input_identity + root/process ownership
why_required: Structural preimage self-hash authenticates contents but not origin
does_not_authorize: Use of the preimage as a new source

required_guard: Bind preserved R5 carrier root to its exact governed build receipt before current consumption
mechanical_proof_required: carrier physical_root_id/logical_stream_digest/member hashes + builder blob + decoder/config + canonical parent SHA
why_required: Current Route-A consumer audits carrier internals but does not reopen raw parent

required_guard: Reject any derivative whose only canonical-parent evidence is a mutable/asserted source_sha256 field
mechanical_proof_required: parent proof must be external to derivative payload or cryptographically chained to governed producer receipt
why_required: A self-consistent wrong-ancestor derivative can otherwise impersonate canonical ancestry
does_not_authorize: Equivalence based on row count or apparent contents

required_guard: Source-specific physical structure fixture must resolve internal header/dictionary/stream disagreements before admission
mechanical_proof_required: accepted hostile fixture identifies the governed physical variable inventory from canonical bytes
why_required: One SHA can contain internally conflicting structural counts

required_guard: Named documentary authority must close release/subset discrepancies before semantic certification
mechanical_proof_required: producer/release provenance for Brazil 1200-vs-1080 discrepancy
why_required: Raw bytes cannot determine whether an official subset/exclusion has semantic authority

required_guard: Refuse source admission when Authority72 class is L2 until named documentary blocker is resolved
mechanical_proof_required: source-specific authority receipt linked to exact affected semantic claims
why_required: Seven sources have genuine authority debt that hashing cannot solve
does_not_authorize: Upgrade of unaffected physical facts into broad certification

required_guard: Provide an exact Candidate-C source binding spec for each admitted source
mechanical_proof_required: source name + canonical SHA + exact governed projection identity + allowed physical realization policy
why_required: Current C registry contains only LiTS_I and WVS7

required_guard: Define a separate CLOSED_35 court scope and 105-cell capability manifest before any universality claim
mechanical_proof_required: exact 35-source denominator + A/B/C cell capability receipts + source-local oracle identities
why_required: Current preflight deliberately requires exactly two sources
does_not_authorize: Inference that current P2 scope already covers 35

required_guard: Issue source-specific GovernedC11Projection packages before generic facade execution
mechanical_proof_required: canonical source SHA -> accepted source authority -> complete projection preimage -> projection identity
why_required: Facade correctly refuses to invent semantics from hashes labels or missingness

required_guard: If the claim is whole-source neutrality then compare a physical-equivalence receipt in addition to I05 semantic parity
mechanical_proof_required: candidate-specific canonical extraction/derivative digest covering every required source-native class must match governed expectation
why_required: I05 terminal is intentionally claim-scoped and can be equal when unprojected physical state differs
does_not_authorize: Replacement of current P2 semantic terminal

required_guard: Retain independent semantic oracle comparison for terminal-visible divergence
mechanical_proof_required: candidate observation must match frozen source-local oracle on projection/release I03 I05 replay negative states
why_required: This is the existing later semantic catch for projected differences

required_guard: Mechanically reject prefiltering flattening sorting or row reindexing before source-row replay identity is sealed
mechanical_proof_required: source snapshot + row ordinal replay map before any mask/form/module operation
why_required: Several Authority72 hazards can change respondent association if filtered first

required_guard: Keep all weight/design variables physical while requiring separate estimand/design authority per source
mechanical_proof_required: raw weight/design preservation + exact source-specific authority for use
why_required: Many Authority72 sources expose multiple or conflicting weights whose values do not choose an estimand

required_guard: Compatibility decoding must remain tagged physical-only through all derivative manifests
mechanical_proof_required: derivative receipt carries COMPATIBILITY_EXECUTION_ONLY__NOT_SOURCE_TEXT_ENCODING_AUTHORITY
why_required: A successful latin1 decode cannot silently become intended source-text authority

required_guard: Run each Authority71 hostile fixture family before declaring source-neutral physical realization
mechanical_proof_required: fixture PASS receipts at exact canonical source SHA and candidate-neutral physical contract
why_required: Authority71 prepared executable hostile burdens precisely because byte identity was insufficient
does_not_authorize: Source certification by preparation status alone

required_guard: Do not promote a bounded P2 PASS into CLOSED_35 source certification without the Source-Native certification rule
mechanical_proof_required: separate disposition proving information-equivalence for every relevant source-native class
why_required: Prevents the exact false inference under test
does_not_authorize: Any broader population weighting pooling or harmonization claim
